737. SHRI RIPUN BORA: 
 
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government proposes to allocate more funds in order to strengthen the Public 
Health Infrastructure and National Health Mission (NHM); 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and 
(d) the steps being taken by Government to improve the Public Health Infrastructure in India 
including the States of North-East?  
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY 
WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
(a) to (d):  The Government has continued to allocate more funds to strengthen the National 
Health Mission (NHM). Allocation under NHM has increased from Rs.27,989 crore in 
2020
-21 to Rs.31,100 crore in 2021-22 Budget Estimate. 
 
“Public Health and Hospitals” is a State subject, hence the primary responsibility 
of strengthening public healthcare system, including the efforts to strengthen public 
healthcare infrastructure, lies with the respective State Governments. However, under 
National Health Mission (NHM), technical and financial support is provided to the 
States/UTs to strengthen the public healthcare system. NHM support is provided to 
States/ UTs for setting up of new facilities as per norms and up-gradation of existing 
facilities for bridging the infrastructure gaps, including in rural areas, based on the 
requirement posed by them. 
 
 
The „India COVID -19 Emergency Response and Health System Preparedness 
Package-I‟ (ECRP -I) of Rs.15,000 Crores has been approved by the Cabinet on 
22ndApril 2020 with an objective to prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by 
COVID-19. Further, the Cabinet has also approved the scheme, “India Covid -19 
Emergency Response and Health Systems Preparedness Package- II” (ECRP-II) on 08th 
331

July 2021 for an amount of Rs.23,123 Crores. The scheme aims to accelerate health 
system preparedness for immediate responsiveness for early prevention, detection and 
management of COVID-19, with the focus on health infrastructure development. 
 
Beside this, PM-Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) 
was launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister of India for an amount of Rs.64,180 crore. The 
measures under the PM-ABHIM focus on developing capacities of health systems and 
institutions across the continuum of care at all levels, primary, secondary and tertiary, to 
prepare health systems in responding effectively to the current and future pandemics 
/disasters. 
 
Financial support provided to the States /UTs including North East States under 
NHM during the F.Y. 2020-21

iring mental and physical wellbeing of health human resource based on the requirements

RISE IN CASES OF COVID-19 
 
739. SHRI SHAKTISINH GOHIL: 
 
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government has taken cognizance of the alarming rise in COVID-19 cases cross 
the country; 
(b)   whether Government is prioritizing research on potential future variants of the viru s; 
(c) if so, the details thereof including budgetary allocations toward R&D and if not, the 
reasons therefor; 
 (d)   whether Government plans to start administration of booster doses of COVID-19  
vaccines to the 18+ years population in light of the rise in cases, if so, the details thereof and if 
not, the reasons therefor; and 
(e)  details of how Government is ensuring accurate data on the number of cases, given the 
increasing usage of home tests?   
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY 
WELFARE  
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
(a) Government of India is keep
ing a close watch over COVID-19 situation in the country 
against COVID-19 to prevent and mitigate the impact of any resurgence of COVID-19 
trajectory in the country. It is also supporting States in their endeavor to manage COVID-19 
since the beginning of pandemic. Given the emergence of mutated variants with variable impact 
on transmissibility, virulence and effectiveness of vaccines, likelihood of resurgence of 
COVID-19 trajectory in the country is monitored by various expert committees under Indian 
Council of Medical Research, Directorate General of Health Services and other relevant 
Ministries/Departments.  
 
341

 (b) The Indian SARS-CoV-2 Genomics Consortium (INSACOG), jointly initiated by the 
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and Department of Biotechnology (DBT) with Council 
for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), 
is a consortium of laboratories to monitor the genomic sequencing & tracking the evolution of 
variations in the SARS-CoV-2. This consortium has 52 laboratories. 
 
(c) An amount of Rs.1670 c rores has been earmarked for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26 
under the PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM- ABHIM) scheme to aid in 
future research and development. Further, a budget of Rs. 60.18 crores has been released to the 
surveillance for SARS –
 COV-2 in India project by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT). 
 
(d) The administration of precaution doses to Health Care Workers, Front Line Workers and 
persons aged 60 years and above has started under National COVID-19 Vaccination Programme 
from 10th January, 2022. Any decision on extension of eligible beneficiaries for precaution dose 
is as per the recommendations of The National Technical Advisory Group on Immunization 
(NTAGI) on the basis of review 
of available scientific evidences. 
 
(e) Before approval of all home test kits, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) 
ensures that each manufacturer develops a robust mobile app for data capture and report 
generation of each home test conducted. ICMR also sends periodic reminders to all home test kit 
manufacturers to ensure data capture. Simple pictorial kit inserts, and videos have been 
developed in multiple languages for each home kit, where modalities and importance of data 
capture are explicitly explained to the user.

reening of these common NCDs is an integral part of service delivery under Ayushman Bharat –

 Health and Wellness Centres. Government is also implementing the

(COTPA 2003) to discourage the consumption of tobacco products in order to protect the
masses from the health hazards attributable to tobacco use. The provisions under
COTPA, 2003 and the Rules made thereunder mandates prohibition of smoking in public
places; ban on sale of tobacco products to and by minors and within 100 yards of

765. DR. AMEEYAJNIK: 
 
 Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE 
be pleased to state: 
a) the details of initiatives taken by Government to save life of patients who required 
organtransplant in the last three years; 
b) whether Government has any plan to ease the eligibility criteria for organ donors who 
wish to donate his/her organ to save someone’s life; and 
c) if so, the details thereof? 
 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY 
WELFARE 
(DR. BHARATI PRAVIN PAWAR) 
 
(a) The Government of India is implementing the National Organ Transplant 
Programme (NOTP) for augmenting organ donation and transplantation in the country to 
save lives of the patients who require organ transplant. Under the programme a three tier 
framework has been set up to provide for an efficient and organized system of organ 
procurement and distribution in the country. This includes an apex level National Organ and 
Tissue Transplant Organisation (NOTTO) at New Delhi and Five Regional Organ and 
Tissue Transplant Organizations (ROTTOs) at Chandigarh, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata and 
Guwahati and State Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisations (SOTTOs) in fourteen 
States. At national level, NOTTO has been mandated to maintain a national registry of organ 
donation & transplantation with regional & state components. NOTTO also monitors organ 
donation & transplantation and facilitates organ and tissue sharing in the shortest possible 
time along with maintaining a data bank of donors who pledge to donate organs. In addition, 
to improve infrastructure for human organ and tissue retrieval, storage and transplantation, 
provisions have been made for setting up of National/ Regional/State Bio-material centres 
and Organ Transplant/retrieval facilities and for strengthening of existing Organ 
Transplant/retrieval facilities. Provision has also been made for training of transplant experts 
including surgeons, physicians, transplant coordinators, etc. Financial support is provided 
for Transplant Coordinators to medical colleges and trauma centres. Financial Support is 
also provided for maintenance of bodies of deceased donors. Similarly various measures are 
taken to increase  awareness on organ donation which include a website www.notto.gov.in; 
and a 24x7 call centre with a toll free helpline number (1800114770). 
 
In last three years under the program funds have been sanctioned for setting up SOTTOs in 
11 States i.e. Punjab, Haryana, UP, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Bihar,

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 770 
ANSWERED ON 08.02.2022 
SOLAR WASTE MANAGEMENT 
770. SMT. VANDANA CHAVAN
Will the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government has formulated any solar waste management policy and if so, the details
thereof and if not, the reasons therefor;
(b) whether Government has data on e-waste generated by discarded solar panels, and if so, the
details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) the steps taken to incentivise reuse/recycling of photovoltaic cells by PV manufacturers at
the end of life cycle, and if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the State/UT-wise details of raw material recovery facilities available for solar e-waste?
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POWER 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
(a) The E-waste (Management) Rules, 2016 under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 cover
disposal and recycling of e-waste (defined under the Rules as electrical and electronic equipment,
whole or in part discarded as waste by the consumer or bulk consu mer as well as rejects from
manufacturing, refurbishment, and repair processes). Solar panels comprise of electrical and
electronic components and hence can be categorised as e-waste.
Environmentally sound management of major constituent materials of solar panels including 
glass, metals and silicon is covered under the Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and 
Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016. Plastics/polymer fractions generated as waste from the 
PV panels are covered under the Plastic Waste Management rules, 2016. 
(b) Data for on e-waste generated from discarded solar panels is not being maintained separately.
(c) A Committee has been constituted under chairmanship of Secretary, MNRE with the mandate
inter-alia to propose an action plan to evol ve a circular economy in solar panel through
reuse/recycling of waste generated.
(d) No commercial raw material recovery facility for solar e-waste is operational in India. A pilot
facility for solar panel recycling and material recovery has been set up by a private company in
Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

2. Revision of the criteria for Right of First refusal (ROFR):
The criteria for granting the Right of First Refusal in chartering of vessels through tender process
has been revised, for promoting tonnage under Indian flag and ship-building in India, so as to
make India a Atma-nirbhar/self-reliant Bharat, in terms of tonnage and ship-building in India.

SHIPPING CONTAINER PROBLEMS
787. SHRI JAWHAR SIRCAR:
Will the Minister of PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the latest position regarding the crisis in freight shipping due to the worldwide container
shortage crisis;
(b) the details of month by month increase in rates on the most important routes from India
over the last two calendar years;
(c) the assistance Government has offered to mitigate this crisis that has a ripple effect
down the entire supply chains, disrupting country's global trade; and
(d) the other problems facing country's shipping industry?
ANSWER
MINISTER OF PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS
(sHRr SARBANANDA SONOWAL)
(a) to (c) (i) The government has adopted a multi-pronged strategy to allay the problem.
The efforts are spearheaded by an inter disciplinary task force which consists of
representatives from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Ports Shipping and
Waterways, Ministry of Railways, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) and
stakeholders like the Federation of Indian Export Organizations (FIEO). The task force after
considerable stakeholder consultation, is taking coordinated action on identified tracks
including pressing additional shipping/container capacity into service including enhanced
import of empty containers by shipping lines to the country, improved operational planning
by facilitating close coordination between exporters and shipping lines, release of
abandoned/detained lseized containers, increasing duty free stay of containers, freight
discounts for empty repositioning by Railways, measures to improve the turnaround times of
containers through tracking and monitoring of dwell times so as to effectively enhance
availability of containers, seeking out possible ways to promote use of bulk/break-bulk
movement by exporters as compared to containerized movement wherever feasible.
(ii) Regular interaction with the Shipping Lines and their association has resulted in
increasing the availability of the number of empty imported (TEUs) containers. So far 1.84
426

-r-
million TEUs have been repositioned by shipping lines. New Services to West Africa, USA,
Europe and Far East has been started by Shipping Lines further increasing containers supply
and availability of space on ships. The SCI has also diverted one 4500 TEUs container ship
'SCI Chennai'engaged in Coastal trade to EXIM trade from 03.10.2021.
(iii) The Directorate General of Shipping (DGS) had issued an Advisory vide Circular No.
26 of 2021 dated 14.09.2021 to the shipping lines freight forwarders / Non-Vessel Operating
Common Carriers (NVOCCs) / Multimodal Transport Operator (MTOs) / Customs House
Agent (CHA) operating in India advising not to levy any special priority charges for
according any priority to the containers. Shipping lines and freight forwarders / NVOCCs /
MTOs / CHAs were also asked to bring this to the attention of the EXIM trade.
(iv) Government of India is not involved in fixing freight rates and thus, the same is not

PAYMENT DUES ON DISCOMS 
 
794  SHRI JAWHAR SIRCAR: 
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether it is a fact that total outstanding dues owed by electricity distribution companies 
(DISCOMs) to power producers have risen to ₹1,13,227 crore in December; 
 
(b)  whether the payment security mechanism under which DISCOMs are required to open the 
Letter of Credit (LC) for getting power supply, is working satisfactorily; 
 
(c)  the position regarding Government’s waiver of penal charges for the late payment of  dues; and 
 
(d)  the fate of the ₹ 90,000 crore liquidity infusion for DISCOMs that Governmen t had 
announced? 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) :  As per information available, total outstanding dues owed by electricity Distribution 
Companies (DISCOMs) to Central Public Sector Generation Companies, Independent Power 
Producers (IPPs) and Renewable Generators as on 31.12.2021 are Rs.95,167 Crores . State-wise 
details of power dues are available at Annexure. 
 
(b) & (c): Payment security mechanisms through Letter of Credit (LC), etc. are integral part of 
most of the Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) between DISCOMs and Generating Companies.  The 
same was linked to despatch of power by the Government vide order dated 28th June 2019. 
 
 The status regarding the Letter of Credit and Late Payment Surcharge is as follows: 
 
1
) The requirement of either making prepayment or giving Letter of Credit (LC) with the entire 
cost of the power was relaxed to 50% during the period 24.03.2020 to 30.06.2020.   Thus, 
DISCOMs were required to either pay in advance or give LC for 50% of the cost of power they 
wanted to be scheduled; the remaining 50% was to be paid within the period given in the PPA, 
failing which the delayed payment surcharge would apply.  This was not applicable for State 
Generators.  
 
2
) Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC), in accordance with the directions issued 
by the Government of India under section 107 of the Act, had issued an order to the effect that 
if any delayed payment by the Distribution Companies to the Generating Companies and inter-
State Transmission Licensees beyond 45 days from the date of the presentation of the bills falls 
between 24.03.2020 and 30.06.2020, the concerned Distribution Companies shall make the 
payment with Late Payment Surcharge (LPS) at the reduced rate of 12% per annum.   
.........2.
 
448

 
- 2 - 
 
3) Further, in order to alleviate the financial stress on the DISCOMS due to higher late payment 
charges (15% to 18%) and also make available funds for Generating Companies, Government, 
on 20.08.2020, has advised the Generating Companies and Transmission Companies to charge 
Late Payment Surcharge at a rate not exceeding 1% per month for all payments made under the 
Liquidity Infusion Scheme from Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) Ltd and Power 
Finance Corporation (PFC) Ltd under Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan with a long repayment 
period upto 10 years.  
 
4
) The Government has notified an Electricity (Late Payment Surcharge) Rules, 2021 on 22 nd 
February, 2021. Late Payment Surcharge dues have been linked to the marginal cost of funds 
based lending rate for one year of the State Bank of India. Thus, it has been rationalized. 
 
(d):  In order to tide over the liquidity problems of the power sector, exacerbated by the 
outbreak of COVID-19, the Government of India announced a Liquidity Infusion Scheme as part of 
Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan on 13 th May, 2020. Under this intervention, Rural Electrification 
Corporation (REC) Ltd. and Power Finance Corporation (PFC) Ltd. are extending special long term 
transition loans up to 10 years to Discoms for liquidating outstanding dues (as on 30.06.2020) of 
CPSE GENCOs & TRANSCOs, IPPs and RE Generators. So far, Loans to the extent of Rs.1,35,497 
Crore have already been sanctioned and Rs.1.03 Lakh Crore have been disbursed as on 31.12.2021. 
The disbursement under the long term transition loans have been linked with DISCOMs undertaking 
specified reform measures.

RURAL AREAS OF THE COUNTRY 
 
796  SHRI TIRUCHI SIVA: 
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  the details of the average hours of continued power supply per day in the electrified 
villages in the country; 
 
(b)  the steps being taken to increase the average hours of continued power supply in the 
villages; and 
 
(c)  the details of the areas identified as no power cut zones, State-wise, district-wise? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (c) : There is adequate availability of power generation capacity in the country.  As per 
independent surveys, the availability of power in surveyed rural areas has gone up from an average of 
12 hours in 2015 to 20.50 hours in the year 2020. In June, 2021, the average availability of power in 
rural areas was 22.17 hours.  Based on the data ported by various utilities on communicable feeder on 
National Power Portal (NPP), State-wise details of rural average hours of power outage are at 
Annexure.
 
 
Interruptions in the supply of electricity are generally on account of constraints in 
distribution network, or financial constraints with some Distribution Companies not having the 
money to pay for power. Supply/distribution of electricity to all consumers is done by the State Power 
Utilities. Government of India has been helping the States through its various schemes including 
Deen
 Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY) and Integrated Power Development Scheme 
(IPDS) to achieve the objective of providing uninterrupted power supply to all households. 
 
 
The DDUGJY scheme was notified by Ministry of Power, Government of India in 
December 2014 for Strengthening and augmentation of sub-transmission & distribution infrastructure 
in rural areas, including metering of distribution transformers/ feeders/consumers. 
 
The IPDS Scheme was notified by Ministry of Power, Government of India, on 
03.12.2014, for strengthening the power sub-transmission and distribution networks in urban areas . 
R-APDRP (Restructured Accelerated Power Development & Reforms Programme) was subsumed 
under IPDS.   
 
Ministry of Power has launched Revamped Distribution Reforms Scheme with the 
goal of 24x7 power supply alongwith financial viability of Distribution Companies.

797 #  SHRI NEERAJ DANGI:  
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  the State-wise details of schemes initiated in the power sector in various States along 
with the State of Rajasthan; 
 
(b)  the details of funds released State-wise during the last three years and the current

A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER 
AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) :    Government of India had launched Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana 
(DDUGJY) in December 2014 for the rural areas with the objectives of electrification of all un-
electrified villages as per Census 2011;  Strengthening and augmentation of sub-transmission & 
distribution infrastructure in rural areas, including construction of HT and LT lines, metering at 
distribution transformers, feeders and consumers; and feeder segregation and electrification of villages 
across the country including Rajasthan. 
 
Government of India had also launched the Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar 
Yojana-Saubhagya in October, 2017 with the objective of achieving universal household 
electrification. The scheme entailed providing electricity connections to all un-electrified households 
in rural areas and all poor households in urban areas in the country. As on 31.3.2019, all households 
were reported electrified by the States, except 18,734 households in Left Wing Extremists (LWE) 
affected areas of Chhattisgarh. Subsequently, seven States namely Assam, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, 
Karnataka, Manipur, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh reported that around 19.09 lakh un-electrified 
households, identified before 31.03.2019, which were unwilling earlier but later on expressed 
willingness to get electricity connection. All these seven States have reported 100% household’s 
electrification as on 31.03.2021. Since the launch of Saubhagya, a total of 2.817 crore households have 
been electrified, upto 31.03.2021.

against which 33,523 households have been electrified as on 31.01.2022.  
In addition, Government of India had launched Integrated Power Development Scheme 
(IPDS) in December, 2014 under which various Distribution Infrastructure projects such as 
Strengthening of sub-transmission and distribution networks in urban areas; Metering of distribution 
transformers / feeders / consumers in the urban areas; IT enablement works; Enterprise Resource 
Planning (ERP); Smart Metering; Gas insulated Sub-stations (GIS); and, Real Time Data Acquisition 
System (RT-DAS). 
So far, projects worth Rs.30,802 Crore [with Government of India (GoI) Grant of   Rs.

798  SHRI SANJAY RAUT:  
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  whether it is a fact that only 20 per cent of Rooftop solar target has been achieved in 
the country till 2022; 
 
(b)  if so, the detai
ls thereof; 
 
(c)  whether it is a fact that consumers are facing several problems during the installation of 
rooftop 
solar panel in their households; 
 
(d)  if so, the details thereof and Government's response thereto; and 
 
(e)  the details of steps taken or proposed to be taken by Government to boost and for 
proper implementation of Rooftop Solar project system in the country? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF POWER 
AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) to (e) : The Ministry of New and Renewable energy (MNRE) is implementing Rooftop Solar 
Programme Phase II, targeting installation of aggregated 4000 Megawatt (MW) capacity rooftop solar 
plants in the residential sector through central financial assistance by the year 2022.  The guidelines 
for the implementation of the Programme were issued on 20.08.2019 and thereafter capacities were 
allocated to the States.  Against this target capacity of 4000 MW, based on the demand received from 
States, around 3160 MW capacity has been allocated to the States ’ im
plementing agencies, out of 
which 1176 MW capacity has been reported installed as on 31.12.2021. 
 
  The implementation of this Programme has got significantly affected due to Covid-19 
pandemic.  Ministry of Power has already given extension of five months time on account of first 
wave of Covid-19 pandemic and another four months time on account of second wave of Covid-19 
pandemic.  The ongoing third wave of Covid-19 pandemic has again affected the progress.  However, 
implementation of the Programme is being reviewed from time to time to make it effective in 
delivering the targeted benefits 
and guidelines are amended accordingly.  Recently MNRE has issued a 
procedure for simplification of Rooftop Solar Programme allowing household owners to get the 
rooftop solar plant installed by themselves or through any vendor of their choice.

800  SHRI RAMKUMAR VERMA:  
 
 Will the Minister of POWER 
be pleased to state: 
(a)  whether Government has details of cumulative hours of electricity cut, if so, the State- 
wise details of past three years; 
 
(b)  whether Government has been able to identify major reasons for prolonged electricity 
cuts across various States in the country and if so, the details thereof; and  
 
(c)  whether Government has taken measures to reduce the electricity cut or power outage 
in the country and if so, the details thereof? 
 
A N S W E R 
 
THE MINISTER OF 
POWER AND NEW & RENEWABLE ENERGY  
 
(SHRI R.K. SINGH) 
 
(a) 
:  There is no shortage of electricity in the country. As per independent surveys, the 
availability of power in surveyed rural areas has gone up from an average of 12 hours in 2015 to 
20.50 hours in the year 2020; and in the urban areas,  the availability of power has gone up to 22.23 
hours. In June, 2021, the average availability of power in rural areas was 22.17 hours and in urban 
areas was 23.36 hours.  Based on the data ported by various utilities on communicable feeder on 
National Power Portal (NPP), State-wise details of average hours of power outage are at    
Annexure.
 
 
(b) & (c) :  Interruptions in the supply of electricity are generally on account of constraints in 
distribution network, or financial constraints with some Distribution Companies not having the 
money to pay for power. Supply/distribution of electricity to all consumers is done by the respective 
State Power Utilities. Government of India has been helping the States through its various schemes 
including Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY) and Integrated Power 
Development Scheme (IPDS) to achieve the objective of providing uninterrupted power supply to all 
households. 
 
The DDUGJY scheme was notified by Ministry of Power, Government of India in 
December 2014 for Strengthening and augmentation of sub-transmission & distribution 
infrastructure in rural areas, including metering of distribution transformers/ feeders/consumers.  
 
The IPDS Scheme was notified by Ministry of Power, Government of India, on 
03.12.2014, for strengthening the power sub-transmission and distribution networks in urban areas. 
R-APDRP (Restructured Accelerated Power Development & Reforms Programme) was subsumed 
under IPDS.

क  सर , म ुमेह, हृदय रोग और आघात की रोकथाम और तनयंत्रण का राष्ट्रीय कायषक्रम (एनपीसीडीसीएस) 
2008 में स्वास््य और पररवार कल्याण मंत्रालय धवारा श ुरू ककया गया था।  आयुष मंत्रालय ने 2015-16 
में एनपीसीडीसीएस क े  साथ आय ुष पध ततयों को जोडने क े  सल ए एक प्रायोकगक पररयोजना श ुरू की थी।  
यह पररयोजना आए राज्यों क े  आए न्जलों में कायाषन्न्वत की गई है।  पररयोजना म ूल्यांकन से पता िलता 
है कक एनपीसीडीसीएस -आयुष प्रायोकगक पररयोजना वाले न्जलों में  आयुवेद /यूनानी/होम्योपैकथक किककत्सा 
का एकीकरण , पारंपररक स्वास््य देखभाल पध ततयों क े  साथ आय ुष पध तत को जोडने का एक कम 
लागत वाला सफल कायषशील मॉडल था।  
भारत सरकार ने प्राथसमक स्वास््य क े न्द्रों (पीएिसी) , साम ुदातयक स्वास््य क े न्द्रों (सीएिसी ) और न्जला 
अस्पतालों (डीएि ) में आय ुष स ुप्रव ाओं की  सह -स्थापना करने की कायषनीतत अपनाई है , न्जससे एक ही 
जगह प्रवसभन्न किककत्सा पध ततयों क े  सलए रोकगयों को प्रवकल्प समल सक े । स्वास््य एवं पररवार कल्याण 
प्रवभाग धवारा आयुष किककत्सकों /पैरामेडडक्स की तनय ुन्क्त और उनक े  प्रसशक्षण क े  सलए  सहायता दी  जाती

कदा आरटी -पीसीआर  जांच करवााे  तिा 7 कदाों क े  वलए घर पर क्वारंटीा रहाे  का प्रावधाा ककया गया है।  
 
स्वास््य और पररवार कल्याण मंत्रालय कोववड-19 क े  वववभन्न पहलुओं जैसे कक वायंत्रण और सर्वसलांस, 
जांच, क्लीवाकल प्रबंधा प्रोटोकॉल, कोववड तपरांत पररणाम आकद क े  प्रबंधा क े वलए तकाीकी मागसदशसा 
प्रदाा कराा जारी रखे हुए है। एम्स, कदल्ली और भारतीय वचककत्सा संघ क े  सहयोग में सभी राज्यों क े  वलए 
स्वास््य और पररवार कल्याण मंत्रालय की तत्क ृ िता क ें द्र पहल क े अंतगसत क्लीवाकल प्रबंधा प्रोटोकॉलों का 
प्रचार-प्रसार भी ककया गया  है। 
 
कोववड -19 महामारी से वापटाे क े  वलए तैयारी और अाुकक्रया से जुडे तपायों की समीक्षा कराे क े  वलए 
क ें द्रीय स्वास््य मंत्री क े  स्तर पर वविय ववशेिज्ञों सवहत सभी संबंवधत वहतधारकों क े  साि वायवमत समीक्षा

बैठक ें  कराे क े  अलावा वीवडयो कॉन्फ्र ें ससंग क े माध्यम से राज्यों/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों क े साि भी समीक्षा बैठक ें 
की जाती रही हैं। राज्यों/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों को वाम्नवलवखत कक्रयाकलापों की सलाह दी गई है: 
 
 समुदाय  में अंतरराष्ट्रीय यावत्रयों की  स्त  वागरााी।  
 पॉवजरटव  पाए गए व्यवियों के  संपक स में आाे  वाले  व्यवियों का  पता लगााा  और  इा  पर  14 कदाों  के  
वलए ाजर  रखाा । 
 पॉवजरटव ामूाों की तुरंत इासाकोग प्रयोगशालाओं में जीाोम सीक् वें ससंग करवााा।  
 वजा क्षेत्रों में बडी सं्या में पॉवजरटव मामले तभरकर सामाे आते हैं वहां की वागरााी।  
 राज्यों में कोववड-19 जांच की अवसंरचाा को और सुदृढ़ कराा और पयासप्त सं्या में जांच कराकर 
मामलों की शीघ्र पहचाा सुवावित कराा।  
 ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों क े  साि-साि बच्च चों क े  मामलों क े  वलए ईसीआरपी -II क े  तहत स्वास््य अवसंरचाा 
(आईसीयू , ऑक्सीजा लगे वबस्तरों, वेंटी लेटरों आकद की तपलब्धता) की तैयारी सुवावित कराा और  
इसक े  तहत स्वास््य अवसंरचाा का तन्फ् ाया कराा।  
 सभी पीएसए संयंत्रों को चालू कराा , पयासप्त साजो-सामाा , औिवधयां आकद की तपलब्धता सुवावित 
कराा।  
 छोटी तम्र क े  ककशोरों (15-18 विस) क े  साि -साि शेि पात्र जासं्या को कोववड -19 टीकाकरण और 
स्वास््य पररचयास कर्मसयों, र ं टलाइा कर्मसयों और सहरुग् णताओं वाले वृ्धजजाों क े वलए एहवतयाती 
खुराक का टीकाकरण सुवावित कराा।  
 कोववड अाुरूप आदतों का पाला सुवावित कराा।

दरहन : (i) फपय स्टॉक क े उऩमोग क े  भाध्मभ से भूल्म िृवि क े  दौयान प्रबािी हस्तऺेऩ सुर्नजित कयने क े  
र्रए, सयकाय ने 2020 -21 औय 2021-22 भें ककसानों/ककसान उत्ऩादक संगठनों (एपऩीओ) से दरहन की 
खयीद की है। िर्षि 2021-22 क े  र्रए 23 राख भीकिक टन (एरएभटी) क े  फपय स्टॉक का रक्ष्म है। (ii) दारों 
की घयेरू उऩरब्धता फढाने क े  र्रए, तूय औय उड़द को कदनांक 31 भांि 2022 तक ‘भुक्त’ आमात श्रेणी भें

औय 10 % तक  नींे  रामा गमा है। (iv) म्मांभाय क े  साथ उड़द क े  2.5 एरएभटी औय तूय क े  र्रए 1

ऻाऩन (एभओमू) ऩय हस्ताऺय ककए गए हैं। भोिाजम्फक क े  साथ 2 राख भीकिक टन  तूय क े  आमात को औय

भूर शुल्क को 14 अक्ट ूफय 2021 से 32.5 प्रर्तशत से घटाकय 17.5 प्रर्तशत कय कदमा है (ii) नेशरन 
कभोकडटी एंड डेरयिेकटव्स एक्संेंि र्र. (एनएरडीईएक्स) ऩय सयसों क े तेर भें िामदा कायोफाय को र्नरंवफत

भांि, 2022 तक की अिर्ध क े र्रए खाद्य तेरों औय र्तरहनों ऩय स्टॉक सीभा रगा दी है। विर्शष्ट खाद्य 
ऩदाथों ऩय राइसें स की आिश्मकता , स्टॉक सीभाएं औय संंरन प्रर्तफंध हटाने संफंधी (संशोधन) आदेश,

धन िैवश्वक स्तर पर और

(ग )  यकद हााँ, तो तत्सबंिी ब्यौरा क् या है; 
(घ)  राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा की शुरूआत से इसके अंतगगत स् ावपत ककए गए सामुदावयक स्वास््य केन्द्रों 
और जा स्वास््य केन्द्रों का तवमलााडु सवहत राज्य-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; और  
(ङ)  सरकार द्वारा राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा के कायागन्द्वया और प्रगवत का मूल्यांका कराे के वलए क्या

(क ) से (ङ): राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा (एाएचएम) की शुरूआत से इसके तहत जारी की गई और तपयोग की 
गई वावियों का तवमलााडु सवहत राज्य-वार ब्यौरा अाुलग्नक-I पर संलग्न है।  
सरकार ाे राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा (एाएचएम) को सुदृढ़ कराे के वलए और अविक वावियों का आबंटा 
जारी रखा है। एाएचएम के तहत वर्ग 2020-21 में आबंटा 27,989 करोड़ रु.  ा जो वर्ग 2021-22 के 
बजट अाुमाा में बढ़कर 31,000 करोड़ रु. हो गया है।  
एाएचएम के तहत स् ावपत ककए गए सामुदावयक स्वास््य केंरों (सीएचसी) त ा जा स्वास््य केंरों 
(पीएचसी) का तवमलााडु सवहत राज्य-वार ब्यौरा अाुलग्नक-II पर संलग्न है।  
जा स्वास््य त ा अस्पताल राज्य का ववर्य है अत: इस योजाा को तपयुक्त रूप से कियावन्द्वत कराा 
राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र का प्रा वमक त्रदावयत्व है। त ावप, राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा के तहत राज्य/संघ राज्य

क्षेत्रों के सा  वायवमत रूप से चचाग की जाती है। राष्ट्रीय स्वास््य वमशा के कियान्द्वया त ा प्रगवत का 
आंकला कराे के वलए वववभन्न कायग-तंत्र ववद्यामा हैं जो वाम्नााुसार हैं:-  
 एापीसीसी बैठकों के दौराा वपछले वव्ीय वर्ग की कायगवावहयों के ररकॉडग के  प्रमुख बातों 
(वडवलवरेबल ) की समीक्षा,  
 सामान्द्य समीक्षा वमशा (कॉमा ररव्यू वमशा) द्वारा राज्यों का वार्र्गक वारीक्षण कराा जो अन्द्य 
बातों के सा -सा  वव्ीय प्रणावलयों त ा कायग-तंत्रों का अवलोका करता है।  
 वावियों की मााीटररंग त ा प्रबंिा के वलए सावगजवाक वव्ीय प्रबंिा प्रणाली (पीएफएमएस) 
का कियान्द्वया।  
 मंत्रालय के वररष्ठ अविकाररयों द्वारा मााीटररंग संबंिी वायवमत दौरे।  
इसके अवतररक्त, भारत सरकार राष्ट्रीय पररवार स्वास््य सवेक्षण, वजला स्तरीय घरेलू सवेक्षण, वार्र्गक 
स्वास््य सवेक्षण और ामूाा पंजीकरण सवेक्षण जैसे बाह्य सवेक्षणों के माध्यम से एाएचएम के कियान्द्वया 
की समीक्षा/आंकला करती है।  
एाएचएम के तहत प्रगवत की वतगमाा वस् वत अाुलग्नक-III पर दी गई है।

792.  श्री के. सी. रामम ूर्ता:             
क्या विद्युत मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृपा करेंगे  ककिः  
 
(क)  क्या कनााटक में मैंगलोर तापीय विद्युत संयंत्र को फास्ट ट्रैक विद्यु
त पररयोजना के तहत शाममल कर मलया

(ख)  इस संयंत्र की मौजूदा क्षमता ककतनी है और आने िाले िर्षों में उपरोक्त विद्यु
त
 पररयोजनाओं से विद्युत 
क्षमता में ककतनी िृद्धि होगी;  
 
(ग) एमटीपी में उत्पादन कब से श ुरू होने का अन ुमान है ; और  
 
(घ) क ें द्र सरकार द्िारा हररत ईंिन पर जोर देने के मद्देनजर कनााटक में जीिाश्म ईंिन के स्थान पर हररत 
ऊजाा के उत्पादन के मलए ककए जा रहे प्रयासों का ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
विद्युत और निीन एिं निीकरणीय ऊिाा मंत्री 
(श्री आर.के. ससंह) 
 
(क) से (ग) : विद्युत उत्पादन एक लाइसेंस रहहत गनत विधि है। कनााटक में मैंगलोर तापीय विद्य ुत संयंत्र को 
1000 मेगािाट अन ुमाननत क्षमता उत्पादन के साथ फास्ट ट्रैक विद्यु
त पररयोजनाओं के अंतगात श ुरू ककया गया 
था। पररयोजना को बाद में छोड़ हदया गया और चाल ू नहीं ककया गया।  
 
(घ) : सरकार ने देश में निीकरणीय ऊजाा को बढािा देने के मलए अनेक उपाय ककए हैं। इन उपायों में ननम्नमलखखत 
शाममल हैं:  
 
• ऑटोमेहटक रूट के तहत 100 प्रनतशत तक विदेशी प्रत्यक्ष ननिेश (एफडीआई) की अनुमनत ,  
• 30 ज ून , 2025 तक चाल ू की जाने िाली पररयोजनाओं के मलए सौर एिं पिन विद्य ु
त की      अंतर

राज्यीय बबक्री हेतु अंतर-राज्यीय पारेर्षण प्रणाली (आईएसटीएस) प्रभारों का अधित्याग,  
• िर्षा 2022 तक निीकरणीय क्रय दानयत्ि (आरपीओ) हेतु ट्रेजेक्टरी की घोर्षणा, 
• प्लग एिं प्ले आिार पर आरई विकासकतााओं को भूमम तथा पारेर्षण प्रदान करने के मलए अल्ट्ट्रा मेगा 
निीकरणीय ऊजाा पाकों की स्था पना ,  
• प्रिानमंत्री ककसान ऊजाा सुरक्षा एिं उत्थान महामभयान (पीएम-कुसुम) , सौर रूफटॉप चरण -II, 12000 
मेगािाट सीपीएसय ू स्कीम चरण-II आहद जैसी स्कीमें,  
• निीकरणीय ऊजाा की ननकासी के मलए हररत ऊजाा कॉररडोर स्कीम के अंतगात नई पारेर्षण लाइनें बबछाना 
और नई सब -स्टेशन क्षमता का सृजन ,  
• सोलर फोटोिोजल्ट्टक प्रणाली/उपकरणों को लगाने के मलए मानकों की अधिस ूचना ,  
• ननिेशों को आकवर्षात करने एिं सुकर बनाने के मलए पररयोजना विकास प्रकोष्ठ की स्थापना ,  
• धिड से ज ुड़ी सोलर पीिी एिं पिन पररयोजनाओं से विद्यु
त की खरीद के मलए टैररफ आिाररत प्र
नतस्पिी 
बोली प्रकक्रया हेतु मानक बोली हदशा -ननद ेश,

793.  श्री सतीश चंद्र िुबे :  
           
क्या विद्युत मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा करेंगे  ककिः  
 
(क)  विद्युत मंत्रालय क े  अंतगगत आने िाले विभिन्न सािगजननक क्षेत्र क े  उपक्रमों क े  द्िारा विगत तीन िर्षों क े  
दौरान सीएसआर ननधि क े  अंतगगत क्षेत्र-िार और मद -िार खर्ग की गई ननधि का ब्यौरा क्या है ;  
 
(ख) विशेर्षरूप से बबहार सहहत तत्संबंिी राज्य -िार ब्यौरा क्या है ; और   
 
(ग) ककन -ककन उपक्रमों में अिी िी ककतनी सीएसआर ननधि उपलब्ि है ?

तनदेश ददनांक 20.08.2019 को जारी ककए गए थे और उसके बाद राज्यों को क्षमता आबंदटत की गई थी। राज्यों 
से प्राप्त मांग के आधार पर, 4000 मेगावाट की इस लक्षक्षत क्षमता की तुलना में, राज्यों की कायाान्वयन एजेंससयों 
को लगभग 3160 मेगावाट क्षमता आबंदटत कर दी गई है न्जसमें से 31.12.2021 की न्स्थतत के अन ुसार 1176 
मेगावाट क्षमता संस्थावपत ककए जाने की ररपोटा प्राप्त हो चुकी है।
